sections.heading: Core RCS Features That Make Marketing Automation Work

blocks.html: RCS isn't just a prettier SMS. Each feature below is an automation trigger — a tap, a swipe or a read receipt your platform can react to instantly. That's what turns rich media messaging into a high-converting, self-running campaign engine instead of a one-way blast.

items.title: Interactive buttons & quick replies:
items.desc: Customers tap instead of type — "Buy Now", "Track Order", "Talk to Agent". Every tap can trigger the next automated flow, so intent is captured in one touch instead of a typed keyword.

items.title: Rich cards & product carousels:
items.desc: A swipeable carousel is a mini storefront inside the inbox — multiple products, each with an image, description and its own call-to-action button. Perfect for launches, seasonal offers and interactive messaging campaigns.

items.title: Verified business profile:
items.desc: Your logo, brand name and verification badge appear on every message. Customers instantly know it's really you — which is why verified RCS senders see far fewer ignored messages than anonymous SMS headers.

items.title: Webviews for in-chat shopping:
items.desc: Open a catalogue, cart or payment page inside the conversation itself. The customer browses and buys without ever switching apps — the heart of conversational commerce.

items.title: Read receipts & real-time analytics:
items.desc: Track reads, button clicks and carousel swipes per message — not just deliveries. That data feeds straight back into your automation to time follow-ups and improve every RCS campaign.

sections.heading: How to Build High-Converting RCS Campaigns, Step by Step

blocks.html: A high-converting RCS campaign is planned like a conversation, not a broadcast. Whether it's your first RCS marketing campaign or you're moving budget across from SMS marketing, the same five steps apply.

items.title: Define the goal and segment an opted-in audience:
items.desc: Pick one objective — sales, reactivation, feedback — and message only customers who've agreed to hear from you. Segment by purchase history, location and behaviour so every rich card feels relevant.

items.title: Set up event-based triggers and post-purchase flows:
items.desc: Let real events fire the messages — order placed, cart abandoned, delivery out, payment due. Post-purchase flows like order confirmations get opened at several times the rate of bulk email, so automate them first.

items.title: Integrate your CRM for personalization:
items.desc: Connect RCS to Zoho, HubSpot, Salesforce or your custom CRM so every message uses the customer's name, last purchase and preferences — and every tap flows back into the customer record.

items.title: Test on both Android and iPhone:
items.desc: RCS renders slightly differently across devices. Keep card descriptions tight, lead with one clear action button, and preview on both platforms before you hit send.

items.title: Measure, learn, optimize:
items.desc: Use read receipts and click data to refine creative, timing and audience — then let the automation re-run the improved version. That's the loop that compounds into high-converting campaigns.

sections.heading: RCS Messaging Pricing in India: What to Expect

blocks.html: So how much does RCS messaging cost? Like SMS, RCS is billed per delivered message, but rates depend on the message type and the operator. Basic text-only RCS messages are usually priced close to SMS, while rich messages — cards, carousels, media and buttons — carry a premium that their higher click-through rates comfortably justify. A provider platform fee and 18% GST apply on top, billed in INR. As always: ask for a plain rate card before you sign.

items.a: RCS marketing automation combines Rich Communication Services — branded, interactive messages in the phone's native inbox — with automated triggers like order events, cart abandonment and button taps. items.q: How is RCS different from SMS marketing?
items.a: SMS is limited to 160 plain-text characters with delivery reports only. items.q: Does RCS messaging work on iPhone?
